name: Ginger Ale
description: Crisp, naturally spiced ginger ale — a refreshing non-alcoholic option with a clean ginger kick.

name: Toyono Cider
description: A sparkling cider crafted with local Toyono Town apples. Light, refreshing, and naturally sweet — a beloved local specialty.

name: Mineral Soda
description: Premium sparkling mineral water with a clean, crisp finish. A simple, elegant refreshment.

name: Apple Juice
description: Pure, freshly pressed apple juice sourced from local Toyono orchards. Naturally sweet and full of flavor.

name: House-Made Syrup Soda
description: Sparkling soda infused with our seasonal house-made syrup. Ask our staff for today's flavor — it changes with the season.

name: Oolong Tea
description: A smooth, lightly roasted oolong tea — fragrant and refreshing without being heavy. A classic pairing with Japanese cuisine.

name: House-Roasted Coffee
description: Our house-roasted coffee, carefully selected and roasted in-house to bring out deep, rich flavor. Available as a single cup or at a discounted price when paired with a meal.
